title: Pin the agent-skills source to a commit and gate the global skills install on verified checksums
description: In the local checkout applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (repo record pinnedCommit aaa72a040db4c32f3d6488d5e28e2892a68e9ee0), edit src/setup/installSkills.ts (finding location lines 31-41): reference mongodb/agent-skills by an exact commit SHA instead of a branch, commit a sha256 checksum manifest covering every skill and prompt file the skills CLI fetches, and verify each fetched file against that manifest before the ['--yes', 'skills@1', 'add', ..., '-y', '-g'] step installs globally; on a checksum mismatch or an unlisted file, abort with a non-zero exit and copy nothing to the global skills directory. Keep the existing single interactive confirm for the five supported agents (cursor, github-copilot, windsurf, claude-code, opencode) and make the non-interactive path fail closed. Constraints: this is a developer-machine setup script, so no releaseProcess deployment window applies, but the PR needs one approver under the codeReview policy (self-approval not allowed) and must keep the blocking secrets CI gate green.
acceptanceCriteria: src/setup/installSkills.ts references mongodb/agent-skills by an exact commit SHA (resolvable with git ls-remote), not by branch name

Every file the skills CLI fetches is sha256-verified against the committed manifest; a mismatched or unlisted file aborts the install with a non-zero exit before the global skills directory is written
Running the setup with a tampered skill fixture exits non-zero and leaves the agent's global skills directory unchanged

verificationMethod.description: Re-run /probe-agent-graph example-co --app mcp-gateway on the mongodb-mcp-server checkout; the AGENT-ASI04-02 result (fingerprint 571e78ae6bd7409b70f629686dc717e97be3ed379a6bdf584c7b62adc6d8d18e) is no longer produced at src/setup/installSkills.ts

rootCause.description: The setup consumes third-party skill content from mongodb/agent-skills referenced only by branch with the CLI pinned to a major version, so upstream tampering flows unchecked into the global agent configuration
